st.t: If you have no sapphire lantern, use a cut sapphire on an unlit bullseye lantern filled with lamp oil.
Go to the hole in Lumbridge Swamp. If it has no rope on it yet, use a rope on it. Light your sapphire lantern, then enter the hole.

Inside the Lumbridge Swamp Caves, head to the far south-east corner and enter the cave there. You'll cross an agility obstacle on the way. Wall beasts in the wall holes can grab you: wear a spiny helmet, or stop one square before each hole and then run past.
Climb down the rocks and talk to Juna.
Go back up the rocks and use the lit sapphire lantern on one of the light creatures nearby.
Use a chisel on the magic stone.
Head east and climb down the rocks to get back to Juna. Talk to her to complete the quest.
